risk: GPU driver behaviour (Gallium Nine on nouveau, Tegra X1, under Horizon)
why: the boot emulator uses a null D3D9 device; the render gates run Nine on softpipe on the host
mitigation: first launch with the null device to reach the menu headless (logs only), then Nine; S6d shader cache precompiled; GPU errors and device-lost to sdmc:/fnvnx/host.log; deko3d native renderer (S6n) as the structural fix
check: B4, B5, B7 of docs/PERF.md section 9

risk: Real timing and threading: A57 IPC, Horizon scheduling, priority inversion (CSMT worker 0x3B vs main 0x2C)
why: Unicorn runs one thread at a time, in order, with no clock
mitigation: placement table (main on core 0, workers 1-2, core 3 opt-in, off); conservative ini (iNumHWThreads=2, bUseThreadedAI=0); timeouts and a watchdog log in the host

risk: Weak memory ordering: x86 TSO and MSVC volatile vs AArch64
why: the emulator runs one core; races and reordering never show
mitigation: S12 BARRIER/VOLATILE/ATOMIC/POLL classes closed (dmb fences, ldar/stlr for volatile, ATOM1); the multicore race checker of S15 (tests/s15/mtqemu) before the first launch
check: B2/B3 plus a soak of the main menu with all workers on

risk: The host-guest LP64/ILP32 boundary on Horizon (svc arguments, upper register halves, 32BitNoReserved address space)
why: emu_guest.py models the host API in Python; real libnx and the kernel are not run
mitigation: u64-only hostapi with a version in the FNXG header; check_package.py range checks; tests/s5/hello on the device first (ILP32, self-relocation, host calls)
check: tests/s5/hello on hardware before the game guest

risk: Memory limit and layout on the console (application pool, 2 GiB heap region, GPU carve-out, fragmentation)
why: the emulator maps what it is asked for; no system limit applies
mitigation: launch as a title override (full application memory), not as an applet; host.c logs total/used/guest heap at boot and fails early with a message
check: the host's memory line in host.log; peak heap after the first cell

risk: Instruction cache coherence when the host maps the guest code
mitigation: the host maps the guest as code memory through the kernel (no self-modifying copy), and flushes after relocation
check: tests/s5/hello and the first guest boot on hardware

risk: Atmosphere and firmware: exefs override, NPDM kernel capabilities, program id
why: no loader or kernel validates the package in the emulator
mitigation: PROGRAM_ID of an installed title; check_package.py; first run the hello host through the same override
check: the hello package boots; the game package's NPDM accepted

risk: Storage: SD read speed and file names for 9.4 GB of Data (BSA), case sensitivity
why: the farms read host files; no SD timing
mitigation: case-insensitive path mapping in the platform layer; CPU boost while loading (boost_loading=1); loading screen thread
check: time to the main menu and to the first cell on device

risk: Audio and input devices (audren, hid), docked and handheld
mitigation: null fallbacks that keep the game running when a device fails to open (S7)
check: menu navigation with Joy-Con and Pro Controller; sound in the menu

risk: Clocks and thermals: handheld vs docked GPU clock; FastLoad boost drops the GPU to its minimum
mitigation: boost only while the loading screen renders, never driven by IO (J-0115)
